definitions.explanation: A temporary interruption or gap in something continuous. Most commonly used in the negative form 絶え間なく (without pause, incessantly).

examples.japanese: {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}っている。
{工事|こうじ}の{騒音|そうおん}が{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The construction noise continues without a break.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}の{花|はな}びらが{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{散|ち}り{続|つづ}け、{道|みち}はまるでピンクの{絨毯|じゅうたん}のようだった。
examples.english: Cherry blossom petals kept falling without pause, and the path looked like a pink carpet.

notes:
The noun {絶|た}え{間|ま} means a pause or break in something continuous, but it is most commonly used in the adverbial form {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく (without pause, ceaselessly). In fact, {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく is far more common than the bare noun.

USAGE:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく (ceaselessly, without interruption) is the standard usage
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない (unceasing, constant) is the adjective form
- Emphasizes that something continues without any break or pause

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{続|つづ}く: to continue without pause
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない{努力|どりょく}: unceasing effort
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{流|なが}れる: to flow without stopping
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない{騒音|そうおん}: incessant noise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {休|やす}みなく: without rest — simpler and more casual
- ひっきりなしに: incessantly — emphasizes frequency of repeated events
- {間断|かんだん}なく: without interruption — more formal/literary
- {途切|とぎ}れなく: without breaking off — emphasizes continuity
